assumptions: Standard backbone cleavage series with the neutral losses and radical variants requested.
limits: A complete theoretical ladder: a real spectrum shows a subset, with intensities this does not predict.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which theoretical fragment ions does this peptide give, at each charge?

description: Theoretical MS/MS fragment ion ladder of a peptide: a, b, c from the N-terminus and x, y, z from the C-terminus, with neutral-loss and radical variants, at each charge up to a maximum (validated against pyteomics, cross-checked against OpenMS). Takes ProForma modification tags (a signed mass, a Unimod name, or UNIMOD:accession) on residues and termini.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

maxCharge.description: highest fragment charge (every charge from 1 up to it).

sequence.description: peptide: one-letter residues, optionally ProForma tags, e.g. [TMT6plex]-PEPTM[Oxidation]IDE or [+229.162932]-PEPTM[+15.994915]IDE.

name: fragment_ions

ions.description: one row per fragment: ionType, index (residues), charge, name, m/z
